result.milestone_passed_scope: Historical measurement closure only; not broad controller deployment acceptance

milestones.result_note: Complete with a declared FD limitation: 16 / 64 / 256 environments measured 877.744721 / 3,393.919703 / 12,829.080117 env-steps/s; per-world sim/wall was 0.45715873 / 0.44191665 / 0.41761331. All use the same frozen N03/HSM GPU PhysX + Fabric rigid-body workload, 100 warmup + 1000 timed-prefix steps, no render, one shared-load run each. This is not completed tasks/s. Valid 4 / 16 / 64-env process peaks were 4,931 MiB; 256-env peak was 5,061 MiB with 10,002 MiB minimum free and no guard stop. A fixed-overhead model replaced the earlier proportional overestimate, followed by staged measurements. The failed 1-env initialization (0 native steps) remains retained and is excluded from the model. B1 actual tracking passed across 16 Panda worlds: worst position RMS/max 4.1217 / 6.0730 mm and orientation RMS/max 0.81688° / 1.25805°; command and actual speed/acceleration exceedances were 0. Acceleration limiting affected 50,142/403,200 joint-steps (12.4%); speed limiting was 0. The clock recorded 3,600 callbacks / 30.000001565 native s, wall 529.614 s. The original full local FD gate remains false at far-origin x≈22 / 30 m in float32, alongside the independently passed tracking diagnostic; all three earlier failures remain retained. The tracking result covers a benign free-space trajectory only. Subsequent v1 student-state tests failed local command/actual limits. Separate C3 student-stack throughput is now measured at16/64/256 with full cache and diagnostics, as reported above; it is a different workload with recorded actual-motion violations, not task or safety acceptance.

High-rate peak magnitudes and exact ticks are unavailable. The 46,000 / 41,811 geometry-feasibility candidates for N03 / N12 are not training admissions or evidence that every safety gate passed. disclosures: This page describes the approved phase-2 plan and a dated local evidence summary.
A completed expert reliability measurement does not establish learned-policy performance, recovery capability or a phase-2 milestone pass.
No formal M1–M4 results have been measured. Retained v1 single-task BC20 in-sample native diagnostics are0/20 per task with controller-limit failures; v2 fitting remains train-only.

Qualification nominal task success and measurement integrity are separate from training admission. Earlier qualification nominal traces lack raw per-tick verifier evidence; training admission is 0. Four data-boundary regressions do not establish task-level verifier acceptance.
Ma and Mb measurement reports are closed with declared limitations; N12 strict local safety did not pass every local gate.
Both task takeover sets use 50 episodes from 20 source scenes. Their Wilson intervals are descriptive episode intervals, not independent-task generalization evidence.
Only three N03 cases met the independent grasp-interruption opportunity definition; recovery was 3/3 in those cases, not 50 recovery trials.

N12 had 14 observed grasp-interruption opportunities: 7 subsequent sampled regrasp-and-task successes, 6 failed tasks and 1 task completion without sampled regrasp evidence. Two prefix-unsafe cases remain in the full denominator; this observation-based definition is not exhaustive fault coverage.

BC20 losses are measured on admitted training samples only. They do not establish native student task success, shifted robustness or formal M1–M4 performance; formal method training updates remain 0.
